name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ウマ娘 プリティーダービー スペシャルウィーク
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Uma Musume Pretty Derby Special Week

description.ja: 『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー 』 よりスペシャルウィーク が Figure-rise Standard シリーズで商品化 ‼
description.en: Special Week from “Uma Musume Pretty Derby” is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!!

description.ja: • スカートは前後左右で分割され大きく可動域を確保することができる。その構造は広がる動きにも対応し、シルエットを崩さずに前傾姿勢で走る姿を決めることができる。
description.en: • The skirt is divided into front, back, left and right sections, allowing for a wide range of motion. Its structure allows for wide movement, allowing you to lean forward while running without compromising your silhouette.

description.ja: • スペシャルウィークのピュアな表情、元気いっぱいな動きも魅力的に演出。
description.en: • Special Week's pure expression and energetic movements are also appealing.

description.ja: 表情パーツはタンポ印刷で再現された１種、水転写式デカールで再現する表情２種が付属。
description.en: One type of expression part is reproduced with tampo printing, and two types of expressions are reproduced with water transfer decals.

description.ja: • １パーツ単位で構造を追求。組み立てるだけでカラフルに“勝負服”ができあがる。上体を反ることで躍動感ある走りを再現。
description.en: • Pursuing the structure of each part. Just by assembling, you can create a colorful “competition outfit”. By arching the upper body, it reproduces a dynamic running feeling.

description.ja: • 靴底の蹄鉄はシールで再現。靴の前後を分割することで、地面を蹴る姿もしなやかに表現。
description.en: • The horseshoes on the soles are reproduced with Seal. By splitting the front and back of the shoe, it gives a supple look when kicking the ground.

description.ja: • 頭部は効果的にパーツを分割。表情が付けられる耳や髪の色分け、リボンなども細かく表現。
description.en: • The head is effectively divided into parts. The ears, hair coloring, and ribbons that can be used to express expressions are also detailed.

description.ja: • 表情付きハンドパーツが左右４種類付属。
description.en: • 4 types of left and right hand parts with expressions are included.

description.ja: • クリア成形の台座が付属。支柱を背中に接続し、走る姿でボディを保持することができる。
description.en: • Comes with a clear molded base. By connecting the pillar to the back, you can hold the body while running.

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(タンポ印刷)×1種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (tampo printing) x 1 type

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ(水転写式デカール)×２種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (water transfer decal) x 2 types
